recognize_zh: PAX5 染色中，深棕色核陽性的是散在的小型 B 細胞，而右側細胞質豐富、界線清楚的大型腫瘤細胞核為陰性；腫瘤細胞失去 PAX5 等 B 細胞標記是 PEL 的特點。
features: Strong nuclear PAX5 staining in numerous small background B cells
Large tumor cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and distinct cell borders are PAX5-negative
Negative large cells form a cohesive cluster at right and are scattered elsewhere
Weak non-specific cytoplasmic/dendritic staining in the background
Positive small cells serve as an internal positive control
describe_en: PAX5 immunohistochemistry shows strong nuclear staining in numerous small background B lymphocytes, which serve as an internal positive control. The large neoplastic cells, with abundant pale cytoplasm, distinct borders and vesicular nuclei, lack nuclear PAX5 and are best seen as a cohesive cluster on the right. Findings demonstrate loss of the B-cell program in the tumor cells, consistent with primary effusion lymphoma (extracavitary) in conjunction with HHV8 positivity.

ddx.vs: Large cells retain nuclear PAX5 and CD20 expression.
Also PAX5/CD20-negative, but HHV8 (LANA-1) is negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells show weak (dim) rather than absent nuclear PAX5, with CD30 and CD15 positivity.
